beats.say: 25 years: Harry Kane finally brings the Ballon d'Or home.
He claimed the prestigious trophy on Monday 26 October during a glittering ceremony in London.
For every football fan in the UK, this is the moment we have been waiting for since the last Englishman won.
The BBC says the evening was a massive event that lasted nearly two and a half hours.
It is the ultimate individual prize in the sport, and it now belongs to a homegrown hero.
This win means the long wait for English glory is over, making it the most significant night for your favorite sport in a generation.
